title: host.massadd
description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given hosts.

hosts.description: Hosts to be updated. The hosts must have only the hostid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

groups.description: Host groups to add to the given hosts. The host groups must have only the groupid property defined.

interfaces.description: Host interfaces to be created for the given hosts. See the Host interface object (reference/hostinterface/object).

macros.description: User macros to be created for the given hosts. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

templates.description: Templates to link to the given hosts. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

hostRef.description: Reference to an existing host by hostid only.

hostGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing host group by groupid only.

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template by templateid only.
